units.source_text: 我刚剃度，脑袋一片青痕。

en.t: I had just taken the tonsure, and my head was covered with bluish traces of the razor.

units.source_text: 产生一种像是空气紧贴在我的头上似的感觉。

en.t: It gave me the feeling that the air was pressed tightly against my head.

units.source_text: 这是一种奇妙的危险的感觉，仿佛自己头脑中思索的事以一层薄薄的、敏感的、容易损伤的皮肤同外界的物像接触似的。

en.t: It was a strange and dangerous sensation, as though the things I thought about in my mind were touching the forms of the outside world through a thin, sensitive, easily wounded layer of skin.
